The only guard is `test_linked_paths_at_the_cap_leave_the_subject_reserve_in_the_marker`, which needs jq and was skipped in the sandbox. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). minimax, luna and glm raised it as a hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1); sonnet raised it as both a finding and a hardening suggestion.

  WHY: If the fixture is deleted or renamed, the test keeps passing on synthetic data instead of failing, which hides a coverage gap. All severities given were NIT (mapped to low); minimax gave none. sonnet chose not to re-raise this because the fixture is not in its checkout.
